::: {.callout-note}
## Compare Current and Future State metrics

1. Upload the CSV exported from `current-primary.qmd` (`current-primary.csv`, or the existing `current_state_metadata.csv` export).
2. Upload `future-primary.csv` from `future-primary.qmd`.
3. Select **Compare latest records** to join the newest timestamped record for each process node and calculate metric variances.
4. Edit baseline, target, or calculated cells directly, and add any custom metrics needed for the review.
5. Export `gap-analysis.csv`. Your browser will prompt for the download; save or move it into `output/`.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof gap_analysis_workspace = {
  const gap_metadata_columns = new Set([
    "timestamp",
    "component",
    "process_node",
    "node",
    "template",
    "baseline_timestamp"
  ]);
  const gap_state = {
    current_records: [],
    future_records: [],
    rows: []
  };

  const gap_workspace = document.createElement("div");
  gap_workspace.className = "gap-workspace";

  const gap_import_card = document.createElement("section");
  gap_import_card.className = "gap-card";
  const gap_import_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  gap_import_heading.textContent = "Import map metadata";
  const gap_import_help = document.createElement("p");
  gap_import_help.textContent =
    "CSV files stay in this browser tab. For each process node, only the record with the latest valid ISO timestamp is compared.";
  const gap_import_controls = document.createElement("div");
  gap_import_controls.className = "gap-controls";
  const gap_current_label = document.createElement("label");
  gap_current_label.textContent = "Current State CSV (current-primary.csv)";
  const gap_current_file = document.createElement("input");
  gap_current_file.type = "file";
  gap_current_file.accept = ".csv,text/csv";
  gap_current_label.append(gap_current_file);
  const gap_future_label = document.createElement("label");
  gap_future_label.textContent = "Future State CSV (future-primary.csv)";
  const gap_future_file = document.createElement("input");
  gap_future_file.type = "file";
  gap_future_file.accept = ".csv,text/csv";
  gap_future_label.append(gap_future_file);
  const gap_compare = gap_button("Compare latest records");
  gap_import_controls.append(gap_current_label, gap_future_label, gap_compare);
  gap_import_card.append(gap_import_heading, gap_import_help, gap_import_controls);

  const gap_results_card = document.createElement("section");
  gap_results_card.className = "gap-card";
  const gap_results_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  gap_results_heading.textContent = "Gap comparison";
  const gap_results_help = document.createElement("p");
  gap_results_help.textContent =
    "Improvement assumes lower values are better: (baseline − target) ÷ |baseline|. Yellow cells are directly editable.";
  const gap_table_wrap = document.createElement("div");
  gap_table_wrap.className = "gap-table-wrap";
  const gap_table = document.createElement("table");
  gap_table.className = "gap-table";
  const gap_head = document.createElement("thead");
  const gap_head_row = document.createElement("tr");
  [
    "Process node",
    "Metric",
    "Baseline value",
    "Target value",
    "Absolute change (Δ)",
    "Percentage improvement (%)",
    "Gap status"
  ].forEach((label) => {
    const heading = document.createElement("th");
    heading.scope = "col";
    heading.textContent = label;
    gap_head_row.append(heading);
  });
  gap_head.append(gap_head_row);
  const gap_body = document.createElement("tbody");
  gap_table.append(gap_head, gap_body);
  gap_table_wrap.append(gap_table);
  gap_results_card.append(gap_results_heading, gap_results_help, gap_table_wrap);

  const gap_custom_card = document.createElement("section");
  gap_custom_card.className = "gap-card";
  const gap_custom_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  gap_custom_heading.textContent = "Add Custom Metric";
  const gap_custom_controls = document.createElement("div");
  gap_custom_controls.className = "gap-controls";
  const gap_custom_component = gap_labeled_input("Process node", "text");
  const gap_custom_metric = gap_labeled_input("Metric", "text");
  const gap_custom_baseline = gap_labeled_input("Baseline value", "text");
  const gap_custom_target = gap_labeled_input("Target value", "text");
  const gap_add_custom = gap_button("Add Custom Metric");
  gap_custom_controls.append(
    gap_custom_component.label,
    gap_custom_metric.label,
    gap_custom_baseline.label,
    gap_custom_target.label,
    gap_add_custom
  );
  gap_custom_card.append(gap_custom_heading, gap_custom_controls);

  const gap_export_card = document.createElement("section");
  gap_export_card.className = "gap-card";
  const gap_export_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  gap_export_heading.textContent = "Export";
  const gap_export_controls = document.createElement("div");
  gap_export_controls.className = "gap-controls";
  const gap_export = gap_button("Export Gap Analysis Log");
  const gap_export_help = document.createElement("span");
  gap_export_help.textContent =
    "Downloads gap-analysis.csv with source timestamps, overrides, and custom metrics. Place it in output/.";
  gap_export_controls.append(gap_export, gap_export_help);
  gap_export_card.append(gap_export_heading, gap_export_controls);

  const gap_status = document.createElement("p");
  gap_status.className = "gap-status";
  gap_status.setAttribute("role", "status");
  gap_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  gap_workspace.append(
    gap_import_card,
    gap_results_card,
    gap_custom_card,
    gap_export_card,
    gap_status
  );

  function gap_button(label) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = label;
    return button;
  }

  function gap_labeled_input(label_text, type) {
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.textContent = label_text;
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = type;
    label.append(input);
    return {label, input};
  }

  function gap_notify(message) {
    gap_status.textContent = message;
  }

  function gap_parse_csv(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [];
    let field = "";
    let quoted = false;
    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const character = text[index];
      if (quoted) {
        if (character === '"' && text[index + 1] === '"') {
          field += '"';
          index += 1;
        } else if (character === '"') {
          quoted = false;
        } else {
          field += character;
        }
      } else if (character === '"') {
        quoted = true;
      } else if (character === ",") {
        row.push(field);
        field = "";
      } else if (character === "\n") {
        row.push(field);
        rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        field = "";
      } else if (character !== "\r") {
        field += character;
      }
    }
    if (quoted) throw new Error("The CSV contains an unclosed quoted value.");
    if (field || row.length) {
      row.push(field);
      rows.push(row);
    }
    if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error("The CSV has no metadata records.");
    const headers = rows[0].map((header, index) =>
      (index === 0 ? header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "") : header).trim()
    );
    if (!headers.includes("timestamp") || !gap_component_header(headers)) {
      throw new Error("Each CSV must contain timestamp and component (or process_node) columns.");
    }
    return rows.slice(1)
      .filter((values) => values.some((value) => value !== ""))
      .map((values) => Object.fromEntries(
        headers.map((header, index) => [header, values[index] ?? ""])
      ));
  }

  function gap_component_header(headers) {
    return ["component", "process_node", "node"].find((header) =>
      headers.includes(header)
    );
  }

  function gap_component(record) {
    return String(
      record.component ?? record.process_node ?? record.node ?? ""
    ).trim();
  }

  function gap_latest_records(records) {
    const latest = new Map();
    records.forEach((record) => {
      const component = gap_component(record);
      const timestamp = Date.parse(record.timestamp);
      if (!component || !Number.isFinite(timestamp)) return;
      const existing = latest.get(component);
      if (!existing || timestamp > Date.parse(existing.timestamp)) {
        latest.set(component, record);
      }
    });
    return latest;
  }

  async function gap_read_file(file, label) {
    if (!file) throw new Error(`Choose the ${label} CSV first.`);
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw new Error(`Choose a ${label} CSV smaller than 5 MB.`);
    }
    return gap_parse_csv(await file.text());
  }

  function gap_number(value) {
    if (String(value).trim() === "") return null;
    const number = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
  }

  function gap_format(number) {
    return Number.isInteger(number)
      ? String(number)
      : String(Math.round((number + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100);
  }

  function gap_calculate(row) {
    const baseline = gap_number(row.baseline_value);
    const target = gap_number(row.target_value);
    if (baseline === null || target === null) {
      row.absolute_change = "";
      row.percentage_improvement = "";
      row.gap_status = "⚪ Not calculated";
      return;
    }
    row.absolute_change = gap_format(target - baseline);
    const improvement = baseline === 0
      ? (target === 0 ? 0 : null)
      : ((baseline - target) / Math.abs(baseline)) * 100;
    row.percentage_improvement =
      improvement === null ? "" : gap_format(improvement);
    row.gap_status = improvement === null
      ? "⚪ Not calculated"
      : improvement >= 20
        ? "🟢 On Target"
        : improvement >= 0
          ? "🟡 Moderate Gap"
          : "🔴 Critical Gap";
  }

  function gap_join_records() {
    const current = gap_latest_records(gap_state.current_records);
    const future = gap_latest_records(gap_state.future_records);
    const components = new Set([...current.keys(), ...future.keys()]);
    const rows = [];
    [...components].sort().forEach((component) => {
      const baseline_record = current.get(component);
      const target_record = future.get(component);
      const metrics = new Set([
        ...Object.keys(baseline_record || {}),
        ...Object.keys(target_record || {})
      ]);
      [...metrics]
        .filter((metric) => !gap_metadata_columns.has(metric))
        .sort()
        .forEach((metric) => {
          const row = {
            process_node: component,
            metric,
            baseline_value: baseline_record?.[metric] ?? "",
            target_value: target_record?.[metric] ?? "",
            absolute_change: "",
            percentage_improvement: "",
            gap_status: "",
            current_timestamp: baseline_record?.timestamp ?? "",
            future_timestamp: target_record?.timestamp ?? "",
            is_custom: "false"
          };
          gap_calculate(row);
          rows.push(row);
        });
    });
    return rows;
  }

  function gap_editable_cell(row, field) {
    const cell = document.createElement("td");
    cell.contentEditable = "true";
    cell.spellcheck = false;
    cell.textContent = row[field];
    cell.addEventListener("input", () => {
      row[field] = cell.textContent.trim();
      gap_workspace.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
    if (field === "baseline_value" || field === "target_value") {
      cell.addEventListener("blur", () => {
        gap_calculate(row);
        gap_render();
      });
    }
    return cell;
  }

  function gap_render() {
    gap_body.replaceChildren();
    gap_state.rows.forEach((row) => {
      const table_row = document.createElement("tr");
      const component = document.createElement("td");
      component.textContent = row.process_node;
      const metric = document.createElement("td");
      metric.textContent = row.metric;
      table_row.append(
        component,
        metric,
        gap_editable_cell(row, "baseline_value"),
        gap_editable_cell(row, "target_value"),
        gap_editable_cell(row, "absolute_change"),
        gap_editable_cell(row, "percentage_improvement"),
        gap_editable_cell(row, "gap_status")
      );
      gap_body.append(table_row);
    });
  }

  gap_compare.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      gap_compare.disabled = true;
      const [current_records, future_records] = await Promise.all([
        gap_read_file(gap_current_file.files?.[0], "Current State"),
        gap_read_file(gap_future_file.files?.[0], "Future State")
      ]);
      gap_state.current_records = current_records;
      gap_state.future_records = future_records;
      gap_state.rows = gap_join_records();
      if (gap_state.rows.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("No comparable metric columns were found.");
      }
      gap_render();
      gap_workspace.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
      gap_notify(`Compared ${gap_state.rows.length} metrics across the latest process records.`);
    } catch (error) {
      gap_notify(error.message);
    } finally {
      gap_compare.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  gap_add_custom.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const process_node = gap_custom_component.input.value.trim();
    const metric = gap_custom_metric.input.value.trim();
    if (!process_node || !metric) {
      gap_notify("Enter both a process node and metric name.");
      return;
    }
    const row = {
      process_node,
      metric,
      baseline_value: gap_custom_baseline.input.value.trim(),
      target_value: gap_custom_target.input.value.trim(),
      absolute_change: "",
      percentage_improvement: "",
      gap_status: "",
      current_timestamp: "",
      future_timestamp: "",
      is_custom: "true"
    };
    gap_calculate(row);
    gap_state.rows.push(row);
    gap_render();
    [
      gap_custom_component.input,
      gap_custom_metric.input,
      gap_custom_baseline.input,
      gap_custom_target.input
    ].forEach((input) => { input.value = ""; });
    gap_workspace.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    gap_notify(`Added custom metric ${metric} for ${process_node}.`);
  });

  function gap_csv_value(value) {
    return `"${String(value ?? "").replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
  }

  gap_export.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (gap_state.rows.length === 0) {
      gap_notify("Compare CSV files or add a custom metric before exporting.");
      return;
    }
    const columns = [
      "export_timestamp",
      "current_timestamp",
      "future_timestamp",
      "process_node",
      "metric",
      "baseline_value",
      "target_value",
      "absolute_change",
      "percentage_improvement",
      "gap_status",
      "is_custom"
    ];
    const export_timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const records = gap_state.rows.map((row) => ({export_timestamp, ...row}));
    const lines = [
      columns.map(gap_csv_value).join(","),
      ...records.map((record) =>
        columns.map((column) => gap_csv_value(record[column])).join(",")
      )
    ];
    const blob = new Blob([lines.join("\r\n")], {
      type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = "gap-analysis.csv";
    document.body.append(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    gap_notify("Gap Analysis log ready. Save or move gap-analysis.csv into output/.");
  });

  Object.defineProperty(gap_workspace, "value", {
    get: () => ({rows: structuredClone(gap_state.rows)})
  });

  gap_render();
  return gap_workspace;
}
```
